note: 主播形象不随 skill 分发：每个工程在 brief.json 的 hosts 里登记自己的主播（references/new-avatar.md）。这里放的是实测过的提示词、动作、语速和切段规则。

model.name: grok-video-1.5
model.note: 价格和上限以 list_models / estimate_cost 为准；换模型先过 model-routing

acts.full: warm eye contact, expressive face, natural hand gestures
acts.pip: calm explaining tone, small nods, occasionally glancing down as if reading a screen, small pointing gestures
acts.vlog: relaxed lifestyle vlogger sharing a favorite tool, natural small head tilts and nods, one hand comes up briefly in a casual gesture
acts.depth: medium shot with generous headroom and plain background visible on both sides of the head and shoulders (for text-behind-subject graphics), calm confident delivery

prompt_templates.selfie:
The {who} in {ref} talks straight into the phone's front camera, same selfie framing, lighting and outfit as the reference, like a friendly vlogger {purpose}: {act}. Handheld selfie feel with only a very slight natural sway. Speaks {language}, clearly lip-synced, in a {voice}:
“{line}”
Sound: only the voice and quiet room tone, no music, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
prompt_templates.studio:
The {who} in {ref} talks straight to the camera, same framing, backdrop, outfit and soft lighting as the reference, like a friendly presenter {purpose}: {act}. Locked-off camera, no zoom. Speaks {language}, clearly lip-synced, in a {voice}:
“{line}”
Sound: only the voice and quiet room tone, no music, no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text of any kind.

animal_note: 动物主播在 who 里写清物种（orange cat / Shiba Inu），并在 purpose 后加：its mouth clearly opens and closes in sync with the words
disclosure: 内容由 AI 数字人演绎
